```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(survival)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. 路径与配置 (替换原脚本第 1 节，移除本地目录创建逻辑)
# ==============================================================================
# 注意：如果 Rmd 在根目录，这里可能改为 "data/ADTTE.csv" 或 here::here("data", "ADTTE.csv")
input_file <- "../data/ADTTE.csv"

os_timelist <- c(3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24)
treatment_display_order <- NULL
display_column_positions <- c(1, 2, 3, 5)
report_group_labels <- c("Ib期CRC", "Weekly给药", "Bi-weekly给药", "CRC合计")

table_title <- paste0("Table 14.2.3.1 ", "总生存期-所有晚期结直肠癌患者-安全性分析人群")
data_extract_date <- "2025-08-01"
data_cutoff_date  <- "2025-08-01"

special_subject_footnote <- paste0(
  "受试者112002属于Phase II CRC患者，仅服用了JAB-21822，",
  "未使用西妥昔单抗治疗，因此按照西妥昔单抗Weekly和",
  "Bi-weekly给药总结时不纳入，仅在合计中体现。"
)

crc_combined_label <- "CRC合计"
total_group_label  <- "合计"

# ==============================================================================
# 2~4. 辅助函数 (原脚本第 3~4 节，直接原样复制，无需修改)
# ==============================================================================

parse_numeric_safely <- function(x) {
  x <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  suppressWarnings(readr::parse_double(x, na = c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "NULL")))
}

is_nonmissing_csv <- function(x) {
  x <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(x))
  !is.na(x) & !x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "NULL")
}

sas_round_1 <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_real_, floor(x * 10 + 0.5 + 1e-12) / 10)
}

format_1_decimal <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, sprintf("%.1f", sas_round_1(x)))
}

format_estimate_ci <- function(estimate, lower, upper, ne_text = "NE") {
  estimate_text <- ifelse(is.na(estimate), ne_text, format_1_decimal(estimate))
  lower_text <- ifelse(is.na(lower), ne_text, format_1_decimal(lower))
  upper_text <- ifelse(is.na(upper), ne_text, format_1_decimal(upper))
  paste0(estimate_text, " (", lower_text, ", ", upper_text, ")")
}

format_npct <- function(n, denominator) {
  n <- ifelse(is.na(n), 0L, as.integer(n))
  if (is.na(denominator) || denominator <= 0L) return(paste0(n, " (NE)"))
  percentage <- 100 * n / denominator
  paste0(n, " (", format_1_decimal(percentage), "%)")
}

get_strict_quantile_estimate <- function(fit, prob) {
  target_survival <- 1 - prob
  if (is.null(fit$time) || is.null(fit$surv) || length(fit$time) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  crossing_index <- which(fit$surv < target_survival)
  if (length(crossing_index) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  fit$time[min(crossing_index)]
}

extract_survival_quantiles <- function(fit, probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75)) {
  empty_result <- tibble(percent = probs * 100, estimate = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_)
  quantile_result <- tryCatch(quantile(fit, probs = probs, conf.int = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(quantile_result)) return(empty_result)
  
  get_numeric_vector <- function(x, expected_length) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(rep(NA_real_, expected_length))
    x <- as.numeric(x)
    if (length(x) < expected_length) x <- c(x, rep(NA_real_, expected_length - length(x)))
    x[seq_len(expected_length)]
  }
  
  lower_value <- get_numeric_vector(quantile_result$lower, length(probs))
  upper_value <- get_numeric_vector(quantile_result$upper, length(probs))
  estimate_value <- map_dbl(probs, ~ get_strict_quantile_estimate(fit = fit, prob = .x))
  
  tibble(percent = probs * 100, estimate = estimate_value, lower = lower_value, upper = upper_value)
}

calculate_km_quantiles <- function(data, time_var = "AVAL", status_var = "STATUS") {
  empty_result <- tibble(percent = c(25, 50, 75), estimate = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_, avalc = rep("NE (NE, NE)", 3))
  if (nrow(data) == 0L) return(empty_result)
  
  analysis_data <- tibble(time = as.numeric(data[[time_var]]), status = as.numeric(data[[status_var]])) %>%
    filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(status), time >= 0, status %in% c(0, 1))
  
  if (nrow(analysis_data) == 0L) return(empty_result)
  
  fit <- tryCatch(survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = analysis_data, conf.type = "log-log", conf.int = 0.95), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(empty_result)
  
  extract_survival_quantiles(fit = fit, probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75)) %>%
    mutate(avalc = format_estimate_ci(estimate = estimate, lower = lower, upper = upper))
}

calculate_survival_at_times <- function(data, times, time_var = "AVAL", status_var = "STATUS") {
  analysis_data <- tibble(time = as.numeric(data[[time_var]]), status = as.numeric(data[[status_var]])) %>%
    filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(status), time >= 0, status %in% c(0, 1))
  
  empty_result <- tibble(timelist = times, survival = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_, avalc = "NR")
  if (nrow(analysis_data) == 0L) return(empty_result)
  
  fit <- tryCatch(survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = analysis_data, conf.type = "log-log", conf.int = 0.95), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(empty_result)
  
  max_observed_time <- max(analysis_data$time, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  map_dfr(times, function(current_time) {
    if (current_time > max_observed_time) {
      return(tibble(timelist = current_time, survival = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_, avalc = "NR"))
    }
    fit_summary <- tryCatch(summary(fit, times = current_time, extend = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit_summary) || length(fit_summary$surv) == 0L) {
      return(tibble(timelist = current_time, survival = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_, avalc = "NR"))
    }
    survival_value <- as.numeric(fit_summary$surv[1])
    lower_value <- as.numeric(fit_summary$lower[1])
    upper_value <- as.numeric(fit_summary$upper[1])
    
    if (is.na(survival_value)) {
      display_value <- "NR"
    } else if (survival_value == 0) {
      display_value <- "0"
    } else {
      lower_text <- ifelse(is.na(lower_value), "NE", format_1_decimal(lower_value * 100))
      upper_text <- ifelse(is.na(upper_value), "NE", format_1_decimal(upper_value * 100))
      display_value <- paste0(format_1_decimal(survival_value * 100), " (", lower_text, ", ", upper_text, ")")
    }
    tibble(timelist = current_time, survival = survival_value, lower = lower_value, upper = upper_value, avalc = display_value)
  })
}

# ==============================================================================
# 5~15. 数据读取与处理 (原脚本核心部分，直接复制，仅数据读取方式修改)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. 检查文件
if (!file.exists(input_file)) stop(paste0("未找到 ADTTE CSV 文件。\n预期位置：", input_file))

# 2. 读取数据 (改用 read.csv 并强制字符，替代原来的 read_csv 逻辑)
adtte_raw <- read.csv(
  file = input_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  colClasses = "character", 
  na.strings = c("", "NA", ".", "N/A", "NULL"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(adtte_raw) <- toupper(str_trim(names(adtte_raw)))

# 3. 验证变量
required_vars <- c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "SAFFL", "STARTDT", "AVAL", "CNSR", "TRTGRPN", "TRTGRP", "COHORT", "EVNTDESC")
missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(adtte_raw))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0L) stop(paste0("ADTTE CSV缺少以下必要变量：\n", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")))

# 4. 准备数据
adtte <- adtte_raw %>%
  mutate(
    USUBJID = str_trim(as.character(USUBJID)),
    PARAMCD = str_trim(as.character(PARAMCD)),
    SAFFL = str_trim(as.character(SAFFL)),
    STARTDT = str_trim(as.character(STARTDT)),
    TRTGRP = str_trim(as.character(TRTGRP)),
    COHORT = str_trim(as.character(COHORT)),
    EVNTDESC = str_trim(as.character(EVNTDESC)),
    AVAL = parse_numeric_safely(AVAL),
    CNSR = parse_numeric_safely(CNSR),
    TRTGRPN = parse_numeric_safely(TRTGRPN)
  ) %>%
  filter(toupper(PARAMCD) == "OS", toupper(SAFFL) == "Y", is_nonmissing_csv(STARTDT))

if (nrow(adtte) == 0L) stop("筛选 PARAMCD='OS', SAFFL='Y', STARTDT非缺失后没有记录。")

invalid_cnsr <- adtte %>% filter(!is.na(CNSR), !CNSR %in% c(0, 1))
if (nrow(invalid_cnsr) > 0L) stop(paste0("CNSR存在0和1之外的取值：", paste(sort(unique(invalid_cnsr$CNSR)), collapse = ", ")))

# 5. 生成分析组
adtte_original <- adtte %>% mutate(ANALYSIS_TRTGRPN = TRTGRPN)
adtte_total <- adtte %>% mutate(ANALYSIS_TRTGRPN = 999)
adtte_crc <- adtte %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(coalesce(TRTGRP, ""), fixed("CRC")) |
      (str_detect(coalesce(TRTGRP, ""), fixed("其他")) & str_detect(coalesce(COHORT, ""), fixed("ACRC")))
  ) %>%
  mutate(ANALYSIS_TRTGRPN = 888)

adtte_2 <- bind_rows(adtte_original, adtte_total, adtte_crc)

# 6. 治疗组定义与显示顺序
get_group_label <- function(data, group_id) {
  if (group_id == 888) return(crc_combined_label)
  if (group_id == 999) return(total_group_label)
  labels <- data %>% filter(TRTGRPN == group_id) %>% pull(TRTGRP) %>% as.character() %>% str_trim() %>% na.omit() %>% unique()
  labels <- labels[labels != ""]
  if (length(labels) > 0L) return(labels[1])
  paste0("治疗组 ", group_id)
}

original_groups <- adtte %>% filter(!is.na(TRTGRPN)) %>% distinct(TRTGRPN) %>% arrange(TRTGRPN) %>% pull(TRTGRPN)
available_groups <- unique(c(original_groups, if (nrow(adtte_crc) > 0L) 888 else numeric(0), 999))

if (is.null(treatment_display_order)) {
  treatment_display_order <- available_groups
} else {
  treatment_display_order <- intersect(treatment_display_order, available_groups)
}

group_metadata <- tibble(group_id = treatment_display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    source_label = map_chr(group_id, ~ get_group_label(adtte, .x)),
    denominator = map_int(group_id, function(current_group) {
      adtte_2 %>% filter(ANALYSIS_TRTGRPN == current_group) %>% summarise(N = n_distinct(USUBJID)) %>% pull(N)
    }),
    original_position = row_number()
  )

valid_positions <- display_column_positions[display_column_positions <= nrow(group_metadata)]
if (length(valid_positions) != length(display_column_positions)) stop("当前数据中的治疗组数量不足，无法选择位置。")

group_metadata <- group_metadata %>%
  filter(original_position %in% valid_positions) %>%
  arrange(match(original_position, valid_positions)) %>%
  mutate(output_position = row_number(), column_name = paste0("GROUP_", output_position))

if (nrow(group_metadata) != 4L) stop(paste0("目标表格要求4个治疗组列，当前选择后为", nrow(group_metadata), "列。"))
group_metadata$report_label <- report_group_labels

crc_n <- adtte_2 %>% filter(ANALYSIS_TRTGRPN %in% c(2, 3)) %>% summarise(N = n_distinct(USUBJID)) %>% pull(N)

# 7. 事件和删失汇总
event_summary_long <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(group_metadata)), function(i) {
  current_group <- group_metadata$group_id[i]
  current_column <- group_metadata$column_name[i]
  current_denominator <- group_metadata$denominator[i]
  current_data <- adtte_2 %>% filter(ANALYSIS_TRTGRPN == current_group)
  
  n_event <- current_data %>% filter(CNSR == 0) %>% summarise(N = n_distinct(USUBJID)) %>% pull(N)
  n_death <- current_data %>% filter(CNSR == 0, str_trim(coalesce(EVNTDESC, "")) == "死亡") %>% summarise(N = n_distinct(USUBJID)) %>% pull(N)
  n_censor <- current_data %>% filter(CNSR == 1) %>% summarise(N = n_distinct(USUBJID)) %>% pull(N)
  
  tibble(
    VARID = 1L, STATID = 1:3,
    ROW_LABEL = c("事件", "    死亡", "删失"),
    COLUMN_NAME = current_column,
    VALUE = c(format_npct(n_event, current_denominator), format_npct(n_death, current_denominator), format_npct(n_censor, current_denominator))
  )
})
event_summary <- event_summary_long %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = c(VARID, STATID, ROW_LABEL), names_from = COLUMN_NAME, values_from = VALUE)

# 8. OS 四分位数
os_quantiles_long <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(group_metadata)), function(i) {
  current_group <- group_metadata$group_id[i]
  current_column <- group_metadata$column_name[i]
  current_data <- adtte_2 %>% filter(ANALYSIS_TRTGRPN == current_group) %>%
    mutate(STATUS = case_when(CNSR == 0 ~ 1, CNSR == 1 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_))
  
  calculate_km_quantiles(current_data) %>%
    mutate(
      VARID = 4L, STATID = match(percent, c(25, 50, 75)),
      ROW_LABEL = case_when(
        percent == 25 ~ "    25%分位数（95% CI）",
        percent == 50 ~ "    中位数（95% CI）",
        percent == 75 ~ "    75%分位数（95% CI）"
      ),
      COLUMN_NAME = current_column, VALUE = avalc
    ) %>% select(VARID, STATID, ROW_LABEL, COLUMN_NAME, VALUE)
})
os_quantiles <- os_quantiles_long %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = c(VARID, STATID, ROW_LABEL), names_from = COLUMN_NAME, values_from = VALUE)
os_header <- tibble(VARID = 4L, STATID = 0L, ROW_LABEL = "总生存期（月） [1]")
for (current_column in group_metadata$column_name) os_header[[current_column]] <- ""
os_section <- bind_rows(os_header, os_quantiles)

# 9. OS 率
os_rate_long <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(group_metadata)), function(i) {
  current_group <- group_metadata$group_id[i]
  current_column <- group_metadata$column_name[i]
  current_data <- adtte_2 %>% filter(ANALYSIS_TRTGRPN == current_group) %>%
    mutate(STATUS = case_when(CNSR == 0 ~ 1, CNSR == 1 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_))
  
  calculate_survival_at_times(data = current_data, times = os_timelist) %>%
    mutate(
      VARID = 5L, STATID = match(timelist, os_timelist),
      ROW_LABEL = paste0("    ", timelist, "个月（95% CI）"),
      COLUMN_NAME = current_column, VALUE = avalc
    ) %>% select(VARID, STATID, ROW_LABEL, COLUMN_NAME, VALUE)
})
os_rate <- os_rate_long %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = c(VARID, STATID, ROW_LABEL), names_from = COLUMN_NAME, values_from = VALUE)
os_rate_header <- tibble(VARID = 5L, STATID = 0L, ROW_LABEL = "总生存率（%）[1]")
for (current_column in group_metadata$column_name) os_rate_header[[current_column]] <- ""
os_rate_section <- bind_rows(os_rate_header, os_rate)

# 10. 反向 KM 随访时间
followup_quantiles_long <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(group_metadata)), function(i) {
  current_group <- group_metadata$group_id[i]
  current_column <- group_metadata$column_name[i]
  current_data <- adtte_2 %>% filter(ANALYSIS_TRTGRPN == current_group) %>%
    mutate(STATUS = case_when(CNSR == 1 ~ 1, CNSR == 0 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_))
  
  calculate_km_quantiles(current_data) %>%
    mutate(
      VARID = 6L, STATID = match(percent, c(25, 50, 75)),
      ROW_LABEL = case_when(
        percent == 25 ~ "    25%分位数（95% CI）",
        percent == 50 ~ "    中位数（95% CI）",
        percent == 75 ~ "    75%分位数（95% CI）"
      ),
      COLUMN_NAME = current_column, VALUE = avalc
    ) %>% select(VARID, STATID, ROW_LABEL, COLUMN_NAME, VALUE)
})
followup_quantiles <- followup_quantiles_long %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = c(VARID, STATID, ROW_LABEL), names_from = COLUMN_NAME, values_from = VALUE)
followup_header <- tibble(VARID = 6L, STATID = 0L, ROW_LABEL = "总生存期随访时间（月） [1]")
for (current_column in group_metadata$column_name) followup_header[[current_column]] <- ""
followup_section <- bind_rows(followup_header, followup_quantiles)

# 11. 合并最终报表数据
final_analysis <- bind_rows(event_summary, os_section, os_rate_section, followup_section) %>% arrange(VARID, STATID)

for (current_column in group_metadata$column_name) {
  final_analysis[[current_column]] <- ifelse(
    final_analysis$STATID != 0 & (is.na(final_analysis[[current_column]]) | final_analysis[[current_column]] == ""),
    "0", final_analysis[[current_column]]
  )
}

# 12. 增加章节之间的空行
section_ids <- unique(final_analysis$VARID)
final_with_blank_rows <- map_dfr(seq_along(section_ids), function(i) {
  current_varid <- section_ids[i]
  section_data <- final_analysis %>% filter(VARID == current_varid)
  if (i < length(section_ids)) {
    blank_row <- tibble(VARID = current_varid + 0.5, STATID = 999L, ROW_LABEL = "")
    for (current_column in group_metadata$column_name) blank_row[[current_column]] <- ""
    bind_rows(section_data, blank_row)
  } else {
    section_data
  }
})

final_display <- final_with_blank_rows %>% select(ROW_LABEL, all_of(group_metadata$column_name))

# ==============================================================================
# 16~19. 渲染 HTML 表格 (替换 flextable 逻辑)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. 准备列名 (注意将 \n 替换为 HTML 的 <br>)
column_labels <- paste0(group_metadata$report_label, "<br>(N=", group_metadata$denominator, ")")
names(final_display) <- c("项目", column_labels)

# 2. 跨列表头
cross_header_text <- paste0("II期 CRC<br>(N=", crc_n, ")")

# 3. 脚注
footnote_lines <- c(
  "以每组受试者人数为分母计算百分数。",
  "[1]：基于Kaplan-Meier估计。"
)
if (exists("special_subject_footnote") && !is.null(special_subject_footnote) && nzchar(special_subject_footnote)) {
  footnote_lines <- c(footnote_lines, special_subject_footnote)
}
footnote_lines <- c(footnote_lines, paste0("数据提取时间：", data_extract_date, "；数据截止时间：", data_cutoff_date))

# 4. 使用 kableExtra 输出
final_display %>%
  kable(
    caption = table_title,
    align = c("l", rep("c", ncol(final_display) - 1)),
    escape = FALSE,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    linesep = ""
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    font_size = 12
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    header = c(" " = 1, " " = 1, cross_header_text = 2, " " = 1),
    bold = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  footnote(
    general_title = "注：",
    general = footnote_lines,
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "2.7in") %>%
  column_spec(2:5, width = "1.6in") %>%
  row_spec(
    row = which(final_with_blank_rows$STATID == 0),
    bold = TRUE
  )



```
